opening.argument: The speaker presents paid OneCoin packages as an earnings opportunity, describing a €3,300 executive package with 30,000 tokens that would become 60,000 after an automatic split. He says participants can earn when the coin price rises, that invested money would grow and later be converted to cash, and that referrals generate commissions usable to upgrade a package. He also cites about 2.3 million naira producing an account worth 16.2 million in roughly a month, while projecting a possible sale yielding about 40 million naira within two months. These claims promote token purchase, appreciation, and related earnings. The supplied material does not independently verify the stated balances, token mechanics, or cash-out outcomes.

citations.quote: This is the executive, issued for 3,300 euros and it has 30,000 token, it's auto split once. So by that time is split, I'm supposed to have 60,000 token.
you can also earn money when the price of one coin goes up
if you'll refer other to the system and you can commission you can use it to upgrade your own package
you want to invest and knowing fully where that, very anytime soon your money would have grown and you can now convert it to cash and get your money out of there
i will have made like 40 million naira within the space of maybe two months
